hero.badge: English Teacher in Ho Chi Minh City
hero.title: Learning English should feel like an adventure
hero.subtitle: I'm an English teacher based in Ho Chi Minh City. For the past 3 years, I've been helping students of all ages discover the joy of speaking English - in classrooms across Go Vap, Phu Nhuan, and Binh Thanh.

courses.title: How We'll Learn Together
courses.subtitle: Every student is different. Here's how I adapt my teaching to meet you where you are.

beginner.title: First Steps
beginner.description: For young learners and complete beginners. We build confidence through games, songs, and lots of patience. No pressure, just progress.

intermediate.title: Finding Your Voice
intermediate.description: You know some English but want to speak more naturally. We'll focus on real conversations, everyday situations, and building fluency.

advanced.title: Polish & Confidence
advanced.description: For students preparing for exams, interviews, or just wanting to master the language. We refine pronunciation, expand vocabulary, and tackle complex topics.

business.title: Young Learners
business.description: Specialized classes for children aged 4-12. I've taught at kindergartens and primary schools across HCMC - I know how to make learning fun.

experience.title: My Teaching Journey
experience.description: I came to Vietnam 3 years ago and fell in love with teaching here. I've worked at ILA Vietnam, Blue Sky Academy kindergarten, and taught in dozens of public schools across Ho Chi Minh City. Each classroom taught me something new about how people learn.
experience.places: ILA Vietnam • Blue Sky Academy • Public Schools across HCMC

approach.title: How I Teach
approach.description: I believe learning happens best when you're not afraid to make mistakes. My classroom is a safe space to try, fail, laugh, and try again. Whether you're 5 or 50, we'll find the approach that works for you.

location.title: Where I Teach
location.description: I offer in-person classes in Go Vap, Phu Nhuan, and Binh Thanh districts. I can come to your home, or we can meet at a cafe or library. Online classes are also starting soon for those who prefer learning from home.

testimonials.title: From My Students
testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from real people I've had the pleasure of teaching

cta.title: Curious about classes?
cta.subtitle: No pressure, no commitments. Let's just have a conversation about your goals.

faq.title: Common Questions
faq.a1: I teach in-person in Go Vap, Phu Nhuan, and Binh Thanh districts in Ho Chi Minh City. I can come to your home, or we can meet somewhere convenient. Online classes are also available.
faq.a2: Everyone! I've taught kindergarteners at Blue Sky Academy, primary school students, teenagers, and adults. Each age group is different, and I adjust my methods accordingly.
faq.a3: It depends on the type of class, location, and frequency. Let's chat about your needs first, and I'll give you a clear quote with no hidden fees.
faq.a4: Yes! Group classes can be more affordable and often more fun. If you have friends or family who want to learn together, we can arrange something.
faq.a5: Patient, encouraging, and adaptable. I focus on communication over perfection. We'll use real conversations, games, music, and whatever helps you learn best.
faq.q6: Can I try a lesson first?
faq.a6: Of course! We can do a short trial session so you can see if we're a good fit. No obligation.
